title: Happy I purchased
text: Happy I purchased. I like these but the white foam rods that come with it to hold it in place continually fall out and the fabric is a dog hair magnet....I just pulled out the the foam rods and it still stayed in place....overall the material is soft and covers a horrible sofa extended its use so happy I purchased
